COMBATCTHUD.Title: Combat
COMBATCTHUD.InitiativeHint: Click: target · Shift+click: add target · Double click: pan · Right click: sheet
COMBATCTHUD.ActionsHint: Shift+click rolls immediately, skipping the difficulty dialog.

Actions.weaponTip: Attack the selected target with this weapon
Actions.reloadTip: Reload: click = full reload · Shift+click = +1 round · right click = −1 round

Controls.hide: Hide HUD (Shift+H to bring it back)
Controls.popin: Bring back to the main window

Damage.empty: Enter a damage value or formula.
Damage.noTarget: Target a token (T) or select an investigator.
Damage.notOwner: You don't have permission to modify {name}.

Cards.empty: CoC7 combat cards will show up here.

Notify.hidden: Combat HUD hidden. Press Shift+H or use the token controls button to bring it back.
Notify.wrongSystem: Combat Cthulhu HUD only works with the Call of Cthulhu 7th Edition (CoC7) system.

Keybindings.popout: Pop out / pop in the HUD (PopOut!)

enabled.name: Show combat HUD
enabled.hint: Turns the HUD on or off in this browser.

onlyInCombat.name: Only during combat
onlyInCombat.hint: Only show the HUD while there is an active encounter on the scene.

maxCards.name: Cards in the HUD
maxCards.hint: How many CoC7 combat cards (attacks, dodges, damage, checks) are kept in the HUD. 0 disables.

clearCards.name: Clear HUD cards
clearCards.hint: When to remove old cards from the HUD, keeping only the current play. The chat keeps all of them.

hideCardsInChat.name: Hide HUD cards from chat
hideCardsInChat.hint: During combat, cards shown in the HUD are hidden from the chat log. They return to the chat once they leave the HUD.

playersQuickDamage.name: Players can use quick damage
playersQuickDamage.hint: Lets players apply damage/healing, only to actors they own.

Tactics.impossible: Maneuver impossible: {target}'s Build ({bT}) exceeds {name}'s ({bA}) by 3 or more.
Tactics.maneuverHint: Rolled with {skill}. The target responds with Dodge or Fighting; the higher success level wins.
Tactics.maneuverRule: {target} responds with Dodge or Fighting (opposed roll). If the maneuver wins, the target {e}.
Tactics.coverOkRule: Dodge succeeded: shots against this character take a penalty die until the end of the round ("In cover" option of the firearm card). They lose their next action.
Tactics.coverKoRule: Dodge failed: no penalty die for the shooters. They still lose their next action.
Tactics.maneuverTip: Maneuver against the targeted token (disarm, knock down, hold…): Build matters, one penalty die per point if the target is bigger, impossible at 3 or more.
Tactics.coverTip: Dive for cover against a shooter: Dodge roll. Success: one penalty die for shooters this round. Either way: lose next action.

e.hold: is held and must break free to act
e.push: is pushed back a few metres
